rawCommits.subject: feat(video): add Seedance models and provider-specific UI constraints
rawCommits.body:
Add Seedance 2.0 and Seedance 2.0 Fast to VIDEO_MODELS. Update
AuraVideoMainPanel with provider-specific resolution options (480p-1080p
for Seedance vs 720p-4k for Veo), duration options (4-15s for Seedance
vs 4-8s for Veo), and a new aspect ratio picker shown only for Seedance
models (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 21:9). Model switching logic
adjusts resolution, duration, and ratio when crossing provider
boundaries. All constraints verified from official BytePlus docs.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: add Seedance models and provider-specific UI constraints

rawCommits.subject: feat(chat): add video to agent mode system constants
rawCommits.body:
Add "video" to AgentMode type, mode order, behavior union, descriptors,
and generation mode mapping. Add generate_video command and tool labels.
Extend GenerationCompleted event type to accept mode "video".
rawCommits.cleanSubject: add video to agent mode system constants

rawCommits.subject: feat(chat): add VideoBlock renderer for video generation results
rawCommits.body:
Create VideoBlock component that renders generated videos inline in chat
messages. Extracts video URL from the normalized imageUrl field (harness
maps video_url to imageUrl). Renders native HTML5 video player with
controls, no autoplay. Register in block registry as generate_video.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: add VideoBlock renderer for video generation results

rawCommits.subject: feat(chat): wire video generation dispatch in chat hooks
rawCommits.body:
Add video dispatch to use-chat-stream (calls generateVideoStream),
build-stream-handler (maps video mode to generate_video tool name),
resolve-send (video ResolvedSend variant + dispatch + queue record),
and chat-ui-store (model selection snaps to DEFAULT_VIDEO_MODEL_ID).
rawCommits.cleanSubject: wire video generation dispatch in chat hooks

rawCommits.subject: fix(chat): add video mode to all chat input bar and stream hook variants
rawCommits.body:
Add generate_video case to the generationMode derivation in both
ChatInputBar and MobileChatInputBar — without this, video mode fell
through to "chat" causing the model picker to show chat models and
messages to be sent as regular chat instead of video generation.

Add video dispatch branch to use-agent-chat-stream (standalone agent
chats) matching the branch already in use-chat-stream (project chats).

Update test mock for isGenerationCommand to include generate_video.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: add video mode to all chat input bar and stream hook variants

rawCommits.subject: fix(chat): add missing video cases in agent stream, progress text, and model sync
rawCommits.body:
Fix GenerationStart progress text in both build-stream-handler and
use-agent-chat-stream to show "Generating video..." instead of falling
through to "Generating 3D model..." for video mode.

Fix GenerationCompleted tool name in use-agent-chat-stream to map video
mode to "generate_video" instead of falling through to "generate_image"
which would render a broken ImageBlock instead of VideoBlock.

Fix syncAvailableModels in chat-ui-store to pin video mode to
DEFAULT_VIDEO_MODEL_ID during adapter syncs, preventing the model from
being reset to a chat model while in Video mode.

Update test mock type to include "video" in selectedMode union.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: add missing video cases in agent stream, progress text, and model sync

rawCommits.subject: fix(chat): map /generate_video slash command to video mode
rawCommits.body:
Fix slash command handler in both ChatInputBar and MobileChatInputBar
to map the generate_video command ID to video mode. Previously fell
through to 3D mode since the ternary only handled generate_image.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: map /generate_video slash command to video mode

rawCommits.subject: feat(video): add chat persistence to video generation handler
rawCommits.body:
Add agent_id and agent_instance_id to GenerateVideoRequest for chat
session resolution. Call resolve_persist_ctx + persist_user_prompt
before generation, pass GenerationPersistArgs to open_generation_stream.
Follows image.rs persistence pattern exactly. Backward compatible —
existing callers without agent scope continue without persistence.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: add chat persistence to video generation handler

rawCommits.subject: feat(video): pass agent/instance IDs for chat video persistence
rawCommits.body:
Add agentId and agentInstanceId to GenerateVideoOptions and pass them
in the request body. Project chats pass agentInstanceId, agent chats
pass agentId. Server uses these to resolve the chat session and
persist video generation turns to chat history.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: pass agent/instance IDs for chat video persistence

rawCommits.subject: feat(video): disable Seedance models with coming soon label
rawCommits.body:
Show Seedance 2.0 and 2.0 Fast in the model picker but greyed out
with "(coming soon)" suffix and disabled click. Applies to both the
AURA Video app and the chat mode model picker. Remove the isComingSoon
checks when BytePlus account is ready.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: disable Seedance models with coming soon label

rawCommits.subject: feat(3d): add chat persistence to 3D generation handler
rawCommits.body:
Add agent_id and agent_instance_id to Generate3dRequest for chat
session resolution. Call resolve_persist_ctx + persist_user_prompt
before generation, pass GenerationPersistArgs to open_generation_stream.
Follows video/image persistence pattern. Backward compatible —
AURA 3D app continues without persistence.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: add chat persistence to 3D generation handler

rawCommits.subject: feat(3d): pass agent/instance IDs for chat 3D persistence
rawCommits.body:
Add agentId and agentInstanceId params to generate3dStream and pass
them in the request body. Project chats pass agentInstanceId, agent
chats pass agentId. Server uses these to resolve the chat session and
persist 3D generation turns to chat history.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: pass agent/instance IDs for chat 3D persistence

rawCommits.subject: fix(video): show preview frame instead of black poster in chat
rawCommits.body:
Add #t=0.5 media fragment to video src in VideoBlock so the browser
seeks to 0.5s for the poster frame instead of showing a black first
frame. Same approach used in the sidekick panel thumbnails.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: show preview frame instead of black poster in chat

rawCommits.subject: feat(video): add download MP4 link to VideoBlock in chat
rawCommits.body:
Add a download link below the video player matching the 3D model
download pattern. Reuses generatedModel3DMeta/Download styles.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: add download MP4 link to VideoBlock in chat

rendered.title: Video generation lands in chat, with Seedance models and 3D persistence
rendered.intro: Today's nightly brings end-to-end video generation into the chat experience: new Seedance models with provider-aware controls in the AURA Video app, a full wiring pass so video mode behaves correctly across desktop and mobile chat input bars, and matching chat-history persistence for both video and 3D generations. Late in the day, the in-chat video player picked up a real preview frame and an MP4 download.

entries.title: Video generation becomes a first-class chat mode
entries.summary: A coordinated push introduces Video as a full agent mode across the AURA Video app, chat input bars, stream hooks, and the server, with Seedance 2.0 / 2.0 Fast added alongside Veo.

items.text: Added Seedance 2.0 and Seedance 2.0 Fast to the AURA Video app with provider-specific resolution (480p–1080p vs Veo's 720p–4k), duration (4–15s vs Veo's 4–8s), and a new aspect ratio picker (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 21:9) shown only for Seedance; switching providers automatically clamps settings to a valid combination.

Wired Video as a full agent mode end-to-end: new generate_video slash command, mode descriptors, tool labels, GenerationCompleted/GenerationStart event variants, and a VideoBlock renderer that plays results inline with an HTML5 player.

Fixed a cluster of fall-through bugs that made early video mode silently behave like chat, 3D, or image: desktop and mobile input bars, agent chat streams, the /generate_video slash command, progress text, and the model picker now all recognize video mode and pin to DEFAULT_VIDEO_MODEL_ID.

On the server, the video generation handler now accepts agent_id and agent_instance_id and persists the user prompt before opening the generation stream, mirroring the image handler while staying backward compatible for callers without agent scope.

entries.title: Video turns persist to chat history, Seedance gated as coming soon
entries.summary: The client now forwards agent identifiers so video generations are saved to chat history, while Seedance models are surfaced but disabled until the BytePlus account is live.

items.text: Chat and agent chat streams now pass agentInstanceId / agentId on video generation requests so the server can resolve the session and persist video turns alongside text in chat history.
Seedance 2.0 and 2.0 Fast are visible in both the AURA Video and chat model pickers but greyed out with a "(coming soon)" suffix and disabled clicks until the BytePlus integration is ready.

entries.title: 3D chat persistence plus polish for the in-chat video player
entries.summary: 3D generation gets the same chat-history persistence as video and image, and the VideoBlock in chat picks up a real poster frame and an MP4 download link.

items.text: 3D generation now persists to chat history end-to-end: the server's Generate3dRequest accepts agent_id / agent_instance_id and runs resolve_persist_ctx + persist_user_prompt, and the client's generate3dStream forwards those IDs from both project and agent chats. The standalone AURA 3D app continues to work without persistence.
VideoBlock now seeks to 0.5s via a #t=0.5 media fragment so chat shows a real preview frame instead of a black first frame, matching the sidekick panel thumbnails.
Added a Download MP4 link beneath the in-chat video player, reusing the styling from the 3D model download.

highlights: Video generation is now a first-class chat mode
Seedance 2.0 models added to AURA Video (gated as coming soon)
Video and 3D generations now persist into chat history
In-chat video player gets preview thumbnails and MP4 download
